scope: Isolated Vite fixture, real game components and committed assets; in-memory transport and framework adapters. Not a production or physical-device benchmark.

desktop.scenario: Warm stationary solo host, Rhenen Teldersweg

portrait.scenario: Fresh portrait launch, solo practice, Rhenen Rijnkade, debug disabled

landscape.scenario: Resized desktop-pointer viewport; does not emulate a coarse pointer or physical phone

limitations: Debug frame metrics clamp stalls to 100 ms
